verdict.rationale: Spline documents an official Spline MCP Server on a dedicated docs page. It connects Claude, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, VS Code and ChatGPT directly to the open editor, is bundled in the desktop app, and registers itself with the clients it finds at launch, so nothing needs installing or configuring. The caveat is that MCP works only through the desktop app, not the browser editor. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection, and documentation of which tools or operations the server exposes.
